title: Final exceptional coefficient equations
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D and coefficient datum C with prime ell different from the characteristic. Let f : X → Y be a separated finite-type morphism between separated finite-type schemes over the fixed algebraic closure of the finite field, and let S be its normalized constructible exceptional coefficient system. Use the raw rational constructible categories, coefficient fields E ≤ F ≤ L, functors Q and G, exceptional comparisons b and gLocalization, scalar functors T, unitors, associators, and integer shift structures of [def-pur-rational-scalar-comparison-data]. Then gLocalization respects the recorded composite shifts; every component b_{F/E,K} is the adjunction transpose coefficientTranspose_{F/E,K} of scalar extension of the exceptional counit following the inverse compact-support comparison; b_{E/E} satisfies UnitEquation for the recorded scalar unitors; and b_{F/E}, b_{L/F}, b_{L/E} satisfy CompositionEquation for the recorded scalar associators.

source.place: Parts (2)-(3), counit normalization and coefficient coherence

proof.text: Unfold the normalized rationalizationComparison and rationalComparison fields of the fixed exceptional coefficient system. Its bShift field gives the localization shift compatibility; its comparison counit and the adjunction Hom bijection give coefficientTranspose; rationalIdentityRight gives the repeated-field unit; rationalCocycle.right gives the three-field composition equation. The wrappers are definitionally the coordinates in def-pur-rational-scalar-comparison-data.
